input.title: Drag-and-drop child drop zone causes thought to ping-pong between expanded and collapsed
input.body:
In trying to fix the failing test for #3275, I ran across some inconsistencies between nested thought drag-and-drop behavior in certain browsers. All of the inconsistencies are related to small differences in the drop zones of thoughts vs subthoughts.

## Steps to Reproduce

```
- A
  - A1
    - A1-1
    - A1-2
  - B
- C
```

1. Clear the cursor
2. Drag C over A (`{ position: 'child' }`)

## Current Behavior

If the pointer is a little bit on the high side (at the very upper tip of the drop zone) then it will ping-pong between expanding and collapsing the thought's children.

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/b502b45f-57f0-4470-8a0e-cf230e3e52ea

## Expected Behavior

When a thought's children expand, the drop zone should remain stable so that the `hoveringPath` does not change.

---

On iOS, I need to wiggle my finger a bit, but I can create the same effect:

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/26316cdd-43a8-4843-95cf-f23814ca5e73

On Android, it doesn't really do the same thing and I need to mess with it more, but can still produce inconsistent results:

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/682d60c7-2b6f-429d-a119-7506e67652a9
